title: Day 2 of making my first game with no dev experience. Thank you for the tips and feedback!
author: Gambo7592
selftext: Just wanted to share some progress, im using AI to build a little chill and cozy game. just trying to dial in on the animations, mechanics and feel of the player models. Having a lot of fun learning and creating as I go. Thanks again to everyone who commented and gave me helpful tips on my last post. I appreciate it! 😊

comments.author: ItsAlwaysTerminal
comments.body: What is your asset pipeline?

replies.author: badger_flakes
replies.body: Wow that’s a bit of a personal question! Oh goodness!

replies.author: Gambo7592
replies.body: Thanks for asking! I use opus 4.6 to write prompts for gemini to create the images in the style i want. Then i use Meshy Ai to turn those into 3D assets. Then i have claude put those into blender to remove the extra polygons and then into unity. From there i tell claude what to tweak in the animations

replies.author: supimjay
replies.body:
Trying to understand, what value does meshy add ontop of just having Claude create the images directly in blender? 

Is meshy better at creating consistent scenes?

replies.author: Gambo7592
replies.body: I tried that and claude just could not replicate the 2D images into a good enough 3D model with blender alone. With Meshy I can put in a few angles on 2D images and it nails the model really well especially the texture. So for me Meshy helps a lot and then claude just cleans up the polygons in blender

replies.author: Lumpy_Conference6640
replies.body:
Just a FYI, you can remesh in Meshy. I lower all of my objects down to 10k polygons, and skin it there. Usually works phenomenally and cuts out the middle child of blender. 

You can also use blender instead of Unity FYI.

Just some stuff I notice might be hat on a hat in your process flow.

replies.author: Gambo7592
replies.body:
Thank you for the advice! I did notice you can remesh in Meshy last night and will probably do that most of the time and use blender as needed. 
What am I supposed to do with all these hat sized hats now 😭

replies.author: Lumpy_Conference6640
replies.body: Hey! You made a process that works. You might need to use it in another project. You never know. :)

replies.author: Gambo7592
replies.body: Appreciate you ❤️

is this meshy ai ad :D? /jk ofc

I often see comment or 2 about \`AI can't make production grade models\`, so I'm naturally curious as aesthetically they look good

replies.author: Gambo7592
replies.body: I appreciate the question. Bc im very aware of how little i probably know, i ask cluade like a million questions about potentials and i often ask it to compare what we are doing in my current project to indutsry standard practices. So that being said after leaving meshy i have claude put the models into blender to get them working properly before going into unity.

replies.body: MCP. ive got claude on my desktop and have it run blender for me i just tell it what im looking for. So i personally dont know the full setup 😅

replies.author: Lumpy_Conference6640
replies.body:
I can speak to this, I'm a CAD designer. Most industry meshs are Crap... Lots of polygons and verts, but they're all bujumbled to the point of a panic attack. 

Meshy is considerably better if only in the fact that they can make them water tight (I.e. 3D printable. 

Comparatively you can do a million vert model just as well as a 10k. 

The only thing they might augment is the animation suite, but legit. Passed that they own this market now.

comments.author: MilesG16
comments.body: Oh I love those walking animations! Do you have any tips? I've been trying Walk/Run/Idle for a few weeks, but it's just not looking right :(

replies.author: Gambo7592
replies.body: I wish i knew exactly how bc Claude is doing the brunt work but heres my workflow.  I'm using Meshy to create the 3D assets from 2D images. Then i have cluade put those into Blender to remove the extra polygons and then into unity. I mess around in there with the feel of the walk and just told cluade i wanted it more squishy, lean teft to right. cute etc. I also have claude do research on specific games that i want a similar animation to and its been killing it so far! wish i had more insight for you

replies.author: MilesG16
replies.body:
That is plenty, thank you! I'll get to work!

Can't wait to see more of your game :)

replies.author: Gambo7592
